tei:div.tei:p: 173) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dbang chog ye shes drwa ba byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs: 174) (Dakini secret letter here) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal la 'dud: gsang sngags lam spyod rnal 'byor pas: sgo gsum smin par byas na: dngos grub med cing 'bras mi 'byung: de phyir skal ldan rjes 'jug rnams: dbang gis smin par byed pa la: sa gzhi brlab dang dkyil 'khor gdan: lha dang bum pa sta gon dang: slob ma sta gos la sogs byang: dbang dngos rdzas kyi rim pa la: rin chen bum pa nyer lngas gtams: bhan+ha mtshan ldan bcud kyis bkang: de steng me long shel rdo dang: sku tsaka rig ma la sogs bsags: de mthar nyer spyod mchod pa dang: ga ṇatsakra dza gad rnams: thabs g.yas shes rab g.yon du bshams: bdag mdun bum pa sgrub pa dang: dkyil 'khor khrus gsol bdag 175) dbang blangs: de nas rdo rje slob ma yis: thal sbyar mos gus dang bcas pas: sko drung gsol ba 'di ltar gdab: kyai: rdo rje slob dpon mchog nyid dang: sgo skyong khro bo dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan las 'phro can: thar pa'i grong du 'jug spro bas: sgo phyes thar pa'i lam bstan gsol: zhes pa lan gsum dang: yang slob dpon gyis: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: khyed cag su yin nga la smos: snying nas thar lam 'jug spro na: dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung nus sam: nus na bla med thar pa'i lam: bdag gis khyod nyid 'jug par bgyi: 176) zhes dang: yang slob bus: kyai ho: gsang chen don gyi bla ma dgongs su gsol: bdag cag 'khor ba'i gnas la sun phyung nas: bla med thar pa'i grong du 'jug spro bas: bdag cag mthu yis thar ba'i skabs ma mchis: mgon po brtse chen khyed kyis drang du gsol: ci bsgos dam las 'da' bar mi bgyid do: lan gsum dang: yang slob dpon gyi gnang ba sbyin pa ni: e ma tshogs smon las 'phro can: khyed rnams las ldan skal ba bzang: nang du 'dong la dad gus gyis: phyag 'tshal bla mar gsol ba thob: thar pa'i lam mchog ngas bstan bya: zhes gnang ba sbyin no: de nas khrus bya bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom:

yid ches phyir ni lo rgyus bshad: maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol gdab ni: kyai: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin khyod dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: rig 'dzin bla ma'i smin byed dbang: yongs rdzogs dam pa gnang du gsol: zhes lan gsum dang: slob dpon gyis: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams kun: thar pa bla med don du gnyer ba yi: snying po'i sgrub la brtson 'grub byed nus na: bdag gis smin byed gdams pa khyod la sbyin: tshul bzhin ldan 177)par mdzod cig rigs kyi bu: lam mchog 'di ni shin tu ngo mtshar che: u dum wa ra las kyang dkon pa'i chos: sgo 'dir lan gcig 'jug pa'i skal ldan na: skye ba gcig gis rig 'dzin gral du 'khod: gang 'brel rnal 'byor grol ba'i lam la 'khod: bu khyod spro ba bskyed la dam tshig rnams: ma nyams tshul bzhin bsrungs la 'bad par 'tshal: zhes gsungs so: de nas skyabs su 'gro ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu: khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs gnas kun gyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad pa o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la 'khor rig 'dzin brgyad dang: grub chen brgyad cu: rje 'bangs nyer lnga la sogs bka' gter gsar rnying gi bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dgongs brda snyan brgyud kyi bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dang: yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad lha mi'i khrom 'tshogs pa ltar bzhugs par bsgoms la skyabs su 'gro ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: ces skyabs 'gro lan gsum zlos: yang sems bskyed pa'i phyir slob dpon gyisaḥ 178) hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu: rang re rnams kyis smin byed kyi dbang zhus nas grol byed kyi gdams pa nyams su blangs nas: ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par byed snyam pas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i phyir 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod:

ces dngaḥ sems bskyed lan gsum zlos: yang yan lag bdun pa'i don dran phyir slob dpon gyis: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig: tshogs bsog pa'i sgo thams cad yan lag bdun par 'du ba yin pas de'i don dran bzhin lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang: dngos su 'byor pa lus longs spyod dang: yid kyis sprul pa dpag med nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi mchod pa'i rdzas su 'os pa thams cad 'bul ba dang: bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis tshe rabs nas bsags dang bsag 'gyur gyi mi dge nyes ltung nyams chag thams cad gnyen po stobs bzhi'i don dran bzhin bshags pa dang: dus gsum kun tu bsags pa'i zag bcas zag med kyi dge tshogs thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba dang: gdul bya'i blor gang 'tshams pa'i theg pa rgya mtsho'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang: 179) ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar du de srid rgyal dang rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i mgon po thams cad sku mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa dang: smin byed dbang dang grol byed bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i dge ba rnams mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad la nye ring chags sdang med par bsngo ba sogs kyi thugs 'dun gyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: ces yan lag bdun lan gsum zlos: yang dam tshig bsgrag pa'i don slob dpon gyis: kyai: rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig: spyir gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa 'di ni dug sbrul gtsug gi nor bu len pa dang 'dra ste: phung 'tshengs gnyis kyi gnad la thug pa yin no: ci'i phyir zhe na: lam 'dir 'jug nas dam tshig gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin bsrungs na: tshe lus 'di ru mchog gi dngos grub tshegs med du thob par 'gyur te: dam las 'das na bar do med par mar gyi zang thal la 'gro bar the tshom med pa yin pas: dam tshig gi gnad rnams mi nyams par bsrung ba gal shin tu nas che'o:

dam tshig gi rim pa la bsam gyis mi khyab kyang bye ba sa ya grangs su brjod cing: phra zhib bsrung dka' ba spyi dang bye brag du ma 180)yod kyang: da lan gyi skabs su rigs lnga'i sdom pa'i dam tshig rnams srog la babs kyang yang dag par bsrung bar bya dgos pas: rkang gnyis rnams kyi gtso bo sangs rgyas dang: skyob pa rnams kyi mchog dam chos: 'dren pa rnams kyi ded dpon dge 'dun te: bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum dang: nyes spyod kyi tshul khrims la bsam ste rang gi sgo gsum gyi bya ba sdom nas mi mthun pa'i phyogs mi dge ba thams cad spang ba dang: dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims la gnas nas sdom pa dang dam tshig gi phyogs su mthun pa'i dge ba'i las phra mo tsam la yang 'bad rtsol gyis rang rgyud la 'byor nges byas te: dran shes bag yod kyi sgo nas gong 'phel byed pa dang: de bzhin sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims la dmigs nas rang don yid byed kyi blo ngan drung nas phyungs te: sems can gyi don kho nar gang la gang 'dul du brtson pa ste: de bzhin rigs kyi dam tshig yin no: lus tha mal du mi gnas par sku'i rten du yi dam lha'i phyag rgya bsgom pa dang ཿ gsung dang thugs kyi rten du dril bu dang rdo rje mi 'bral bar bcang ba dang: thar pa'i lam ston gyi ded dpon: ma rig mun sel gyi sgron me: dngos 181)grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje slob dpon mi spong par bzung ba ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam tshig go: rang gi lus dang longs spyod kyi dngos po thams cad phongs pa med par gzhan la sbyin pa gtong ba dang: chos kyi don tshig gcig yan chad gzhan rgyud la phan par lta ba dang: skyabs bral mgon med kyi rigs nyam thag pa la skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang: dus rnams kun tu sems can gyi don la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rgyun chad med par sgom pa ste:

nyin re bzhin sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi 'di dus drug tu chags med du brtson pa ni: rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig yin no: bya ba'i rgyud dang: spyod pa'i rgyu dang: bla na med pa'i rgyud dang: rnal 'byor gyi rgyud: nyan thos dang: rang rgyal dngaḥ pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa ste: phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum po de dag dus nam yang spang bar mi bgyid pa ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig go: khas blangs ba'i sdom pa thams cad mi nyams par tshul bzhin du bsrung zhing phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sogs la brtson pa ni: las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig yin no: de lta bu'i dam tshig gi gnad rnams mi nyams par tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i 182) rjes zlos mdzod: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te: bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum: nam du yang ni mi gtong ngo: sgo gsum las kyi bya ba sdom: rnam dag tshul khrims gsum la bslab: de bzhin rigs kyi dam tshig 'dzin: rdo rje slob dpon mi spang zhing: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang: dus rnams rtag tu gzung bar bgyi: rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig 'dzin: lus dang longs spyod ltos med par: pha rol nyid du sbyin pa dang: skyabs bral 'jigs las sgrol ba dang: chos dang byams pas rtag tu bskyang: dus drug sbyin pa rnam bzhir brtson: rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig 'dzin: phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum: dam chos tshul bzhin bzung bar bgyi: nam du yang ni mi spang ngo: pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig 'dzin: byang chub sems ni mi spang zhing: sdom pa la ni rab tu gnas: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par brtson: las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig 'dzin: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs mchog dang: yan lag dam tshig 'da' mi bya: mgon po khyod kyis skyabs mdzod la: tshul bzhin 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: lan gsum zlos: de nas dam chu thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'di ni 183)dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: khyed kyi ngag tu blud pa yis:

dam bsrungs tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'thob: nyams na dmyal bar lhung ta re: de phyir dam tshig ma nyams par: srog gi gta' ru bzung bar gyis: badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes bdud rtsi ngag tu blud la: hub gsum byas te sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam: lhag ma g.yon rgyab tu dor la: dam tshig nyams chag thams cad sbyang bar bsam mo: de nas mig dar sbyin pa ni: slob dpon gyis: khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i sgrib pa bsal phyir mig dar res gdong pa bcing ba'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ṇa ye swā hā: zhes dang: me tog sbyin pa ni: slob dpon gyis: 'o: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams khyed cag yi dam gyi lha dang mjal ba na phyag stong par mjal du mi rung zhing dngos grub phra ba dang bar chad mang ba yin pas phyag rten gyi slad du me tog dkar dmar yal 'dab bcu drug gi phreng ba re 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod: badz+ra puṣ+pe trām̐ swā hā: zhes brjod do: de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir sgo skyong rnams la gsol ba 'di ltar gdab: kyai: dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo skyong ba: tshad med bzhi yi rang gzugs gar: sgo ma 184)rnams kyi sgo phyes laḥ dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes brjod pas sgo ba rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shags kyis phyes par bsam la: shar sgo nas phyag 'tshal bar bsam la: na mo gu ru ham̐'u: lho sgo nas phyag 'tshal bar bsam la: na mo gu ru trām̐: nub sgo nas phyag 'tshal bar bsam la: na mo gu ru hrīḥ byang sgo nas phyag 'tshal bar bsam la: na mo gu ru ā: mdun du 'khor par bsam la: na mo gu ru na ma oṃ: zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyi zhal mjal nas dbugs 'byung bar bsam la: de nas slob ma lhar gsal ba ni: slob dpon gyi las chus bran la: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā= sogs/ haṃḥ 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur:

stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin du pad+ma nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i steng: skad cig slob ma rigs kun khyab bdag mchog: o rgyan= sogs nas dkyus ltar spyan 'dren gyi mjug: ye shes pa'i lha tshogs rnams mtsho la kha char babs 185)pa ltar byung nas slob ma'i sgo gsum la thim par gyur: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: zhes pas me tog 'thoraḥ de nas me tog dor ba ni: slob dpon gyis: 'o: rigs kyi bu rnams lhag pa'i lha ngos bzung ba'i slad du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: na mo: dkon mchog gsum bden pa dang: rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs rje yis: bdag gi rig pa'i me tog 'di: sngon nas las 'phro gar yod pa'i: lhag pa'i lha la babs par mdzod: dz+nyā na puṣ+pe sid+dhi trām̐: zhes brjod 'dab bzhi'i do rar dor: rigs dang mthun pa'i ming byin pa ni: 'o: rigs kyi bu rnams khyed cag gi me tog gang la babs pa lha de'i dngos grub thob cing: gsang ba ming gi cod paṇa yang: shar du babs na rdo rje sems dpa' rtsal dang: rdo rje rol rtsal dang: rdo rje ye shes: rdo rje dri med: me long ye shes rtsal dang: rigs de'i lha'i dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur ro: lho ru babs na rin chen dbang rgyal: rin chen don grub: rin chen rol rtsal: rin chen bstan ma: rin chen 'od 'phro: rin chen bkra shis: rin chen bsod nams: rin chen dpal bzang: mnyam nyid klong yangs rtsal dang: rigs de'i lha'i dngos grub 186)kyang thob par 'gyur ro: nub tu babs na pad+ma rig 'dzin: chags bral ye shes: pad+ma don yod: pad+ma kun grol: pad+ma lhun grub: pad+ma rgyal mtshan: pad+ma 'jigs med: pad+ma kun grol rnam rgyal: pad+ma sems dpa' rtsal dang: rigs de'i lha'i dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur ro: byang du babs na karma ye shes: karma don grub: karma nor bu: chos nyid rang grol: 'od gsal lhun grub: karma bstan 'dzin: karma yongs grub rtsal dang:

rigs de'i lha'i dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur ro: dbus su babs na sangs rgyas rgya mtsho: chos dbyings rang grol: rang byung rdo rje: sangs rgyas ye shes: sangs rgyas bzang po: sna tshogs rang grol: sna tshogs mthar phyin: chos nyid rang grol: sangs rgyas sems dpa' rtsal dang: rigs de'i lha'i dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur ro: mtshams rnams su babs na phyogs dang nye ba'i ming dang: dngos grub lha de'i rigs kyi myur ba yin pas ma brjed par yid la zungs shig: lhag lha spyi bor thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: pra ti bh+ri ha ṇa e maṃ: zhes me tog 'thor: de nas mig dar bsal ba ni: slob dpon gyis gser gyi thur mas brda byas la 'di skad do: e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu: khyod 187)nyid ma rig long bas bsgribs: rang byung ye shes zhal ma mthong: da res rdo rje slob dpon gyis: rjes bzung thugs rje'i 'od zer ni: ye shes gser gyi thur ma yis: khyod kyi ma rig ling thog bsal: ye shes snang ba rgyas par gyur: dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa:

ces brjod: brda sprad pa ni: 'o: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams 'di'i don ni rang byung gi ye shes yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu 'di rang la ye nas yod kyang gnyis 'dzin gyi dbang gis ngo ma shes nas ma rig pas mig long nas gzhan la btsal te 'khor bar 'khyams pa: da ni bla ma'i thugs rje'i ye shes kyi gser gyi thur mas ma rig pa'i mig bsal nas gzhi'i chos nyid kyi yon tan mngon sum dbang po'i yul du snang bar byed pa yin no: zhes brjod do: de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: slob dpon gyis: 'o: skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams nyon cig: khyed cag tshogs smon las 'phro dag pa'i skyes bu rigs can du nges pas gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la ltos shig: 'di mthong ba tsam gyis sgrib pa dag cing sgom pa tsam gyis tshe 'dir rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro: 188) 'di ma mthong ba'i skyes bu bsod nams dman pa rnams la 'di'i ming tsam yang brjod par mi byed do: rang byung lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i don bstan pa ni: dbus zlum la 'khyil ba nyag gcig tu yod pa ni: gzhi'i chos nyid gdod nas dag cing spros pa dang bral ba'i brda'o: pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdzes par yod pa ni: ye nas gzhi la rlung lnga'i dwangs ma dang ldan pa'i brda'o: gru chad bzhi ni:'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa'i brda'o: khyams bzhi yod pa ni: phrin las bzhi'i don rang la tshang ba'i brda'o: sgo bzhi ni: tshad med bzhi gzhi la lhun gyis grub pa'i brda'o: rtsigs pa rnam pa lnga ni: ye shes lnga'i rang gdangs gzhan las ma byung bar gzhi la ye nas ldan pa'i brda'o: rta babs brgyad ni: theg pa brgyad kyi don rnams nyag gcig tu gzhi la mnyam par brdal ba'i brda'o: ri dwags brgyad ni: tshogs brgyad gnas su dag pa'i brda'o: 'khor lo bzhi ni: phyi nang gsang gsum bla na med pa'i theg pa dang gzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i brda'o:

gdugs ni: thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i skyabs dang mgon du mchis pa'i brda'o: sna tshogs rdo rje ni: chos thams cad ye nas rang byung rnam par dag 189)cing sku gsum ye shes chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos pa'i brda'o: 'dod rnam ni: sna tshogs snang ba'i 'dod yon thams cad ma spangs rgyan du shar ba'i brda'o: pha gu ni: sems nyid yid bzhin nor bur 'dod dgu rang byung du yod pa'i brda'o: drwa phyed ni: gzhi la yon tan thams cad ma btsal ye rdzogs chen por gnas pa'i brda'o: mda' yab ni: mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi bdag nyid thugs rje phyogs ris med pa'i brda'o: pu shud ni: rig pa don gyi 'od gsal snying por gyur pa'i brda'o: zhing khams ni: rang snang ma 'gags lhun gyis grub pa'i brda'o: rdo rwa ni: dbyings 'pho 'gyur med pa'i brda'o: 'od zer gyi phreng bas bskor ba ni: sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i brda'o: pad phreng ni: chos can chos nyid chen por 'dus shing skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brda'o: dur khrod brgyad kyi bkod pa thams cad ni: tshogs yul dang phra rtog gnas su dag pa'i brda yin: de lta bu'i mtshon byed dag pa'i brda don gyi mthu dang rten 'brel la brten nas: mtshon bya don gyi dkyil 'khor rang snang sku gsum gyi ye shes mngon sum du mthong ba yin 190)pas dga' spro dang dad gus mdzod cig: de nas dbang lha spyan 'dren pa ni: rang nyid rigs 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+wam̐: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha hoḥ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ= shap+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: chos sku nam mkha' lta bur kun la khyab: longs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal:

thugs rje gang 'dul sprul pa'i skur ston pa: bde gshegs sras bcas yongs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces brjod nas rdo rje thal sbyar gyis me tog 'dzin la 'di skad gsol: phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs par bstsal du gsol: smin par mdzad du gsol: grol bar mdzad du gsol: gang bar mdzad du gsol: rgyas par mdzad du gsol: ces brjod pas gshegs pa rnams kyis dgongs pa mdzad: gshegs ma rnams kyis dbang bskur mar: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa brjod: sems ma rnams kyis glu gar bsgyur: 191) khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad nas thams cad dbang gi bya ba la dgyes par bsam la: slob ma rnams rdo rje mi bskyod pa mthing ga mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan par gsal la: hūm̐: ye shes bdud rtsi dri med 'di: khyod kyi spyi bor blugs pa yis: rnam shes phung po gnas dag nas: me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi: dpal ldan thugs kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dbu rgyan thogs la: slob ma rnams rin chen 'byung ldan du gsal la: hūm̐ḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rin chen dbu rgyan 'di gtad pas: tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag nas: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi: dpal ldan yon tan dbang thob shog: oṃ rat+ta kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ḥ gser gyi rdo rje thogs la: slob ma rnams snang ba mtha' yas su gsal la: hūm̐: skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod la: thabs mchog rdo rje 'di gtad pas: 'du shes phung po rnam dag nas: so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi: dpal ldan gsung gi dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ḥ de nas dngul dkar dril bu thogs la: slob ma rnams don yod grub pa ru gsal la: hūm̐ḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod laḥ rin chen dril bu 'di gtad pas:

'du byed 192)phung po rnam dag nas: bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi: dpal ldan phrin las dbang thob shog: oṃ karma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ming dbang ni: slob ma rnams rnal par snang mdzad dkar po mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras par bsgom la: hūm̐: skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod la: rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang: bskur bas gzugs phung rnam dag nas: chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi: dpal ldan sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ bud+dha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: don ngo sprod pa ni: slob dpon gyis: 'o: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams khyed cag la thun mong gi rigs kyi dbang lnga bskur bas: nyon mongs pa lnga dang: phung po lnga gnas su dag nas: sku lnga ye shes lnga mngon du gyur cing gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi smin byed la 'jug pa'i mnga' dbang thob pa yin pas snang rtog lha'i dkyil 'khor du lam du khyer nas phyi nang kun la brnyas pa spang zhing dag snang dang mos gus mdzod cig: de nas dngos gzhi'i lha dbang zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul zhing: gsol pa gdab pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon mchog nyid dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: rig 'dzin bla ma'i dngos gzhi'i dbang: yongs rdzogs gnang ba'i bka' drin 193) zhu: zhes lan gsum zlos: de nas slob dpon gyis: 'o: skal ldan rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig: dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas dbang rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin du byung bar bsam la: de nas bum pa sogs la: hūm̐ hrī: bde chen chos sku'i bum pa ru: lhun grub rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ sprul pa sku yi dbang 'thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas rigs bdag gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gsang ba: byin rlabs ye shes 'byung ba'i mdzod: snang ba mtha' yas dbang bskur mar ro: rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad la:

dbang bsgyur dngos grub 'thob par shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas gtso bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: phrin las gcig bsdus 'gro ba'i mgon: sku gcig bkod pa brgyad du bzhengs: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas dbang bskur ro: lhun grub rig 'dzin sku 'thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: rje mo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: chos sku skye ba med pa las: 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs skur shar: sprul 194) sku ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur nas: mi slob rig sku 'grub par shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas rig 'dzin gyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings ngang las thabs kyi skur bzhengs pa: grub pa brgyad la dbang 'byor rig pa 'dzin: sprul pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro: rim gnyis snying po'i sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: mchog gi dngos grub 'thob pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas rje 'bangs kyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: gdul dka' 'dul phyir gang 'dul skur sprul pa: mdo sngags chos kyi bstan pa'i ba gdan sgreng: mchog gi rig 'dzin sar gshegs 'gro ba'i mgon: rje 'bangs rig 'dzin tshogs kyis dbang bskur ro: don gnyis mthar phyin lung rtogs sgron me 'dzin: 'gro don phrin las mtha' rgyas dbang 'thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas rgyal chen bzhi'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: tshad med bzhi yis 'gro rnams thabs kyi 'dul: phrin las bzhi la mnga' brnyes sgo skyong mdzad: rgyal po chen po sde bzhis dbang bskur ro: las rnams thogs med 'grub 195) pa'i dbang 'thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: des sku bum pa'i dbang thob nas lus bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang: sprul sku'i sa bon gyi skal ba rgyud la bzhag pa yin no:

de nas bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: rang byung bhan+dha yangs pa'i nang: a li ka la'i rang sgra sgrog: rig 'dzin gsung gi bdud rtsi 'khyil: skal ldan bu la sbyin pa yis: ngag sgrib dag nas gsung dbang thob: longs spyod rdzogs skur smin par shog: rtsa sngags: wak+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas sngags 'khor gtad la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin bla ma 'dus pa yi: yang snying gsang sngags kun 'dus 'dis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bzlas pa sngags kyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas sngags phreng gtad la: hūm̐: rin chen phreng ba brgya rtsa 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi lag tu gtad: gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags dang: snying po'i sngags rnams dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags lan gsum rjes su zlos la: mthar thams cad kyis sngags brgya rtsa brjod do: des ngag dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag: ngag gsang sngags bzlas pa la dbang: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba rgyud 196)la bzhag go: de nas rig ma gtad la: slob bu rnams skad cig gis dpal rta mchog rol ba'i skur bsgom mo: zhes brjod nas rig ma sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: bcu drug dga' ster mchog gi pho nya mo: bzhin mdzes lang tsho'i mdangs ldan yid 'phrog ma: bde chen ye shes bskyed mdzad mdza' na mo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rnam gsum bag chags chos nyid chen por bcom: dga' mchog khyad ldan dga' bral ye shes la: dbang 'byor mchog gi rig 'dzin 'grub par shog: rtsa sngags: ma hā dz+nyā na su kha bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des rlung dang thig le'i sgrib pa thams cad dag: rlung bcu las su rung nas rig stong bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i don rgyud la bzhag pa yin no: ces brjod do: spros med rig pa'i rtsal dbang gab thig ltar byas la: ngo sprod kyi mjug tu: 'o: rigs kyi bu rnams chos thams cad ye nas spros pa dang bral bas brjod du med do:

dngos po las 'das pas bsam du med do: gzhi rtsa dang bral bas dper mtshon du med do: 'dus ma byas pas bltar med pa'o: mtshan ma med pa'o: smon pa med pa'o: spros 197) pa med pa'o: rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang ldan pa: spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba: rang byung gi ye shes chen po: rig pa zang thal sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba de ga mngon gyur ngang gnas chen po'i klong du 'ub tu chub par gyis shig: des yid dang kun gzhi'i sgrib pa dag: thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs: tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sa thob: ngo bo nyid kyi don rgyud la bzhag pa yin no: de nas rdo rje slob dpon la mnga' dbang bskur ba ni: dang po gdan khri dang rdo rje dril bu dung g.yas pa' khyil rnams gtad la: hūm̐: srid las 'phags pa'i rin chen sna tshogs khri: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rdo rje dril: chos kyi sgra sgrog dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'di: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la gtad pa yis: khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang thob nas: 'gro rnams smin grol la 'god dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags: sarba dharma rā dza sarba karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: de nas glegs bam gtad la: e ma snod ldan skal bzang rigs kyi bu: gsang ba snying po chos kyi ring bsrel 'di: de ring bdag gis khyod la bka' dbang bstsal: 'di don tshul bzhin zungs la nyams su longs: blo 198)ngan kun rtog dri ma'i skyon spangs nas: yang dag nyid du 'di don shes par gyis: rang don mthar son gzhan don lhur blangs tshe: smin grol chos kyis 'gro rnams srid mtsho las: bsgral te yang dag rnam mkhyen lam mchog la: bgrod pa'i ded dpon chen por khyod mnga' gsol: don gnyis lhun grub dpal la spyod par shog: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba dharma sid+dhi a a āḥ de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings khyab brdal gzhong pa ru: rang byung lhun grub gtor ma bshams:

ye shes rang gsal gtor rgyan byas: rtsa gsum lha tshogs sgrub pa'i rtenaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad la: dbang bsgyur don gnyis mthar phyin shog: rtsa sngagasaḥ ma hā bā liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa a: de nas bka' dbang ni: chos sku kun bzang yab yum: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa': gu ru dga' rab rdo rje: rig 'dzin shrī sing ha: paṇa chen bī ma mi tra: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: lo chen bai ro tsa na: dge slong nam mkha'i snying po: sku'i ḍā ki zhi ba rdo rje mtsho: kun dga' su kha sid+dhi 199)sogs rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol: grol bar mdzad du gsol: ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol: mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa da lta nyid du 'thob par mdzad du gsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ

lan gsum brjod nas me tog 'thor: mtha' rten la sogs spyi dang bstun: de nas dam tshig khas blang dang: sku drin gso phyir maṇ+ḍal phul: bkra shis bsngo smon mtha' brgyan bya: de yis dbang gi las rim rdzogs: sa ma ya: e ma: shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa: pad 'byung thugs bcud snying po'i chos kun 'dus: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gi gdams pa'i bcud: lhun lam zab dbang ye shes drwa ba 'di: snying mig srog las lhag par rab gces kyang: snying nor snying gi bcud 'di phyi rabs don: las ldan zhi ba mtsho yi snying la sbaḥ ma 'ongs nyi shu snyigs ma lnga yi tshe: nga sprul nga dang gnyis med khyim pa'i tshul: chu 'brug lo ba spyi mgrin snying ga ru: bam̐ dang ha ri ni sa'i ri mo bkra: su kha'i ming can zab mo gter ma spyod: pad 'byung sprul pa'i grogs dang phrad nas kyang: gter 200) gnyis bstan pa'i sgron me 'jin pa 'byung: de dus chos 'di'i sgo 'phar rab 'byed nas: chos bdag mchog bzhi ya brgyad nyer lnga sogs: smon lam dus su 'dzoms nas chos 'dir 'phrad: bzang 'brel tshe 'dir mi gnas gtan srid 'thob: ngan 'brel skye ba bdun nas dpal rir 'dren: the tshom med do rdo rje'i bkas mi bslu: snyigs dus spyod ngan rang gis ngom pa'i tshe: pad 'byung phrin las gter gyi ma 'dren na: 'dul ba'i gnyen po su yang yod ma yin: de phyir 'dir 'phrad skyes bu rnams: pad 'byung rje la dus drug gsol ba thob: yal bar ma dor spyi mgrin snying dkyil sgoms: yon tan dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras dang mtshungs: 'chi tshe dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mdun bsus te: 'og min dpal ri'i zhing du 'dren par nges: yal bar ma dor chos 'di nyams su longs: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par smon: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: gter spyod snying gi bu la chos 'di sprod: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig:

dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par srungs: sa ma ya: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: brda thim: gu h+ya: : ces rig 'dzin bla ma'i mchog dbang zab mo 'di yang dus ring mo nas brda don gsal yang rten 'brel lde mig skabs ldan dben tshe brda 'khrugs shin tu che zhing gtan la 'bebs thub ma byung nas btang snyoms su lus skabs 201) zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i dus tshogs 'bul nyin skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa las 'brel rtsal gyi ye shes kyi sku yis sku dang mjal tshe bdag gis zab gter 'khrugs che ba'i lo rgyus rnamasazhus tshe: rje'i phyag mthil nas zab dbang gi brda rnams snyan brgyud du gdams pa bdag gi yid ngor me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin gsal sgrib med par lhag ger shar ba la brten nas lhag chad med par gtan la phab pa yi ge'i rig byed dam ldan slob ma yongs grub rig pa'i rdo rje dang dge btsun tshul khrims rdo rjes bgyis pa'o// maṅga lam// ༈ rigs 'dus dbang bshad skabs su/ da lan gyi skabs su babs pa'i zab chos lus med mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi tshul du gdams pa chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong mdzod kyi chos sde las rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dbang chog ye shes drwa ba byin rlabs char 'bebs zhu ba la dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa sogs/ dbang gi lhan thabs ltar ro/ slob ma lha bskyed skabs las byang gzhung nas sprad dgos na spyan 'dren mthar/ ye shes dbab pa= sogs/ min tshe dbang gzhung bzhin bya'o/ bde rdor pas so// 202)
